description: This file implements the OCIContainer class, providing methods for managing containers via Dobby proxy, including listing, starting, stopping, pausing, resuming, and executing commands within containers. It also handles container state change events and integrates with the WPEFramework plugin system.

classes.name: OCIContainer
classes.description: A class that manages container lifecycle and events through Dobby proxy, exposing JSON-RPC methods for container operations.

methods.name: listContainers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currently running containers from Dobby.

methods.name: getContainerState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a specified container.

methods.name: getContainerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specified container.

methods.name: startContainer
methods.description: Starts a container from an OCI bundle.

methods.name: startContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby spec string.

methods.name: stopContainer
methods.description: Stops a running container, with optional force parameter.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Sends notification that a container has started.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Sends notification that a container has stopped.

methods.name: GetContainerDescriptorFromId
methods.description: Converts container ID to internal Dobby descriptor.

methods.name: stateListener
methods.description: Callback for container state change events.
